parsed.name: 罗德与施瓦茨网络测试仪器
parsed.description: 通过以太网 Socket/VISA 接口通信的罗德与施瓦茨电子测试仪器。该类设备通常用于实验室中的远程配置、状态查询、数据读取和自动化测量，常见于射频与通用电子测试场景。
parsed.description_en: A Rohde & Schwarz electronic test instrument that communicates through an Ethernet socket/VISA interface. Such instruments are commonly used in laboratories for remote configuration, status queries, data readout, and automated measurements in RF and general electronic test setups.

actions.description: 关闭与仪器的网络会话。
actions.description_en: Close the network session to the instrument.

actions.description: 通过指定 IP 地址和端口打开与仪器的原始 Socket 连接。
actions.description_en: Open a raw socket connection to the instrument using the specified IP address and port.

actions.description: 向仪器发送 SCPI 查询命令并读取返回结果。
actions.description_en: Send an SCPI query command to the instrument and read back the response.

actions.description: 设置与仪器通信的超时时间。
actions.description_en: Set the communication timeout for the instrument connection.

actions.description: 从仪器读取原始二进制数据。
actions.description_en: Read raw binary data from the instrument.

actions.description: 向仪器发送 SCPI 命令。
actions.description_en: Send an SCPI command to the instrument.

actions.description: 向仪器发送原始数据或原始命令字符串。
actions.description_en: Send raw data or a raw command string to the instrument.
